correctness.rationale: The independent Poisson means are F P_i+b A_i and the rank-two Fisher determinant is the square of P_1 A_2-P_2 A_1 divided by the product of the means. At zero flux this gives the stated contrast squared divided by b^2 x(1-x). At fixed area, subtracting the density on the circular boundary from the integrand proves strict radial rearrangement, with equality only for the centered disk or its outer-annulus counterpart when optimizing absolute contrast. h_c is positive by strict concavity. Differentiating its normalized square gives the stated N_c. The bracket in N_c'' has one interior zero, so N_c' decreases then increases, has positive endpoint values, and is negative somewhere; N_c therefore has one interior sign change, located below 1/2 by its midpoint sign. The corrected score expansion at small c follows by expanding h_c through its cubic term and differentiating locally near 1/2; convergence there follows uniformly by the interpolation-error bound. At large c, the rescaled objective is bounded by min(sqrt(2y),sqrt(2/y)) for x<=1/2, proving compactness of maximizers away from zero and infinity, and the locally uniform limit has one positive maximizer.
